SRI.E.G.GORDEN,SR.GP  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 06.02.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 W.P.(C)No.11263 of 2019 3 2025:KER:10285  JUDGMENT
The petitioner, states that some of his properties were acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short, the 'Act').
He did not seek for an enhancement originally, of the compensation received.
However, on the basis of an award issued in a connected acquisition by the Sub-Court, Payyannur, the petitioner sought for re-determination with reference to the provisions of Section 28A of the Act.
Originally, the afore application was rejected on technicalities.
Pursuant to the directions of this Court in Ext.P2 judgment, the application filed under Section 28A was restored.
The 3 rd respondent herein issued Ext.P3 dated 07.04.2018, rejecting the application filed under Section 28A, essentially for the reason that the petitioner insisted for the interest component.

2. The petitioner states that Ext.P3, though dated 07.04.2018 was not served on the petitioner and he came to know about Ext.P3 only subsequently when the details were obtained under the Right to Information Act, 2005 (for short 'RTI Act').
With reference to the date on which the details were so obtained under the RTI Act, the petitioner sought a reference, as W.P.(C)No.11263 of 2019 4 2025:KER:10285 seen from Ext.P4.

The afore application is seen rejected as per Ext.P6, essentially with reference to the period of limitation (42 days) prescribed under Section 28A of the Act.
3.
It is in the afore circumstances that the captioned writ petition is filed by the petitioner.

4. I have heard Sri.Saji Joseph Thomas, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.E.G.Gorden,
the learned Senior Government Pleader.

5. The short issue arising for consideration in this writ petition is as regards the rejection of the Kayaloor Padmanabhan vs State Of Kerala on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14467578/
2 reference sought for by Ext.P4.

sentences.text: The application for reference is seen rejected on account of the alleged delay in filing the application with reference to the date of Ext.P3- 07.04.2018.
True, if the afore date-07.04.2018- is taken as the basis, the findings in Ext.P6, cannot be said to be incorrect or arbitrary.
6. However, the petitioner has specifically raised a contention to the effect that, Ext.P3 was not served on 07.04.2018.

He has pointed out that Ext.P3 was obtained only subsequently on 05.11.2018 and with reference to that date alone, the reference application under Section 28A(3), of the Act W.P.(C)No.11263 of 2019 5 2025:KER:10285 ought to have been considered.

I find force in the afore submission, especially when in the statement filed on behalf of the 3rd respondent herein, there is no details as regards the date on which Ext.P3 is served on the petitioner.
7. In such circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled to succeed.
8. Therefore, this writ petition would stand allowed by setting aside Ext.P6.
The competent among the respondents is directed to take note of Ext.P4 and to refer the matter with reference to the provisions of Section 28A of the Act.

Sd/-
